## What & why
<!-- the why matters more than the what -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Conventional commit title
- [ ] No secrets, `node scripts/secret-scan.mjs` is clean
- [ ] Inputs validated server-side (zod `.strict()`) when a route changed
- [ ] `npm run test:related` on the files you touched
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Price rows link an official `source` URL (`CONTRIBUTING.md`)
